bridge_build_provenance: Pre-existing shared library; source-to-binary correspondence was not verified.
environment: Linux, Xvfb 1440x900, Vulkan Lavapipe, isolated OBK_CONFIG_DIR; real X11 XTest keyboard and mouse.
checks: Create part and XY sketch, enter size = 10 mm, draw dimension-driven rectangle; MCPBridge reports healthy DOF zero.
Preview and apply extrude with size as distance; 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices; volume 1000 mm3 and area 600 mm2.
Change size to 20 mm; volume 8000 mm3; undo 1000 mm3; redo 8000 mm3.
Save and reopen through UI; volume 8000 mm3; previously recorded face key is listed and accepted by face appearance assignment.

limitations: Driver uses fixed coordinates for the isolated 1440x900, default UI configuration; it is retained as a historical run record, not a portable test.
Face assignment after reopening modifies the disposable in-memory document; the saved file was not overwritten.
